Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887. Ticked all 3 ACs after independently re-verifying:

- AC1: src/rebar/llm/runner.py:99-108 now frames the thinking/PromptedOutput coupling as a CURRENT Anthropic API constraint — 'a CURRENT Anthropic API constraint (it 400s when extended thinking is on together with a forced/native output constraint), not a workaround for any forced-tool mechanism (none exists in the stack; output is selected by output_mode())'. src/rebar/llm/structured.py:11-16 says the same in the layer-(1) description: '... a live API constraint on the current pydantic_ai output modes, not a relic of any earlier forced-tool mechanism'. No comment implies forced ToolStrategy is the current mechanism. Landed as ad3101be1b1b5b716ea27f7a0a7bd6974fc8a5b9, an ancestor of origin/main.
- AC2: re-ran the cited check myself — 'grep -rn "ToolStrategy\|AutoStrategy\|ProviderStrategy" src/rebar' returns ZERO matches, so the spike's premise is structurally gone and the decision (moot, superseded by the pydantic_ai runtime cutover) is recorded both in this ticket's rescoped Status section and in the two source comments above.
- AC3: 'make lint' is clean when run with the PINNED ruff — this checkout's .venv has ruff 0.15.19 while pyproject pins ruff==0.16.1, and the stale one reports 101 spurious BLE001/T201 errors. With the pinned build: 'uvx ruff@0.16.1 check src tests' -> All checks passed; 'uvx ruff@0.16.1 format --check src tests' -> 1721 files already formatted. 'make typecheck' -> Success: no issues found in 438 source files. The change is on origin/main, which only accepts changes carrying Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1.
